svg.aria-label: 75 overlapping subdomains split into one solid block per GPU, subdomains 1 to 37 on GPU0 and 38 to 75 on GPU1. The forward pass, residual and gradients stay on each GPU's own HBM2 at about 900 GB/s, and only the seam between the two blocks crosses NVLink, at up to 300 GB/s, with no host copy. Each GPU then has a partial u_sum and w_sum, a psum adds them across the two GPUs, and the solution is u_sum divided by the summed windows w_sum.
svg.text: 75 subdomains, each GPU keeps one solid block
up to 300 GB/s, no host copy
forward, residual and grads stay on each GPU’s own HBM2, ~900 GB/s
